ownerDecisions: R8, the biggest call: re-energizing a faulted line to test or burn it is DEADLY across Module 5. This covers 5.1a's coworker (raised from slip), 5.4a/b, 5.8b's LT site (raised from slip) and the gate. Source: lesson 5.4's own 'মারাত্মক ভুল' and the M1 rule that the lesson's 'মারাত্মক ভুল' means deadly. Either confirm it, or rule it a slip module-wide. Then align M4 do_4_4_b, which books 'reclosing after a re-blow' as a slip; the clean split is instant blast with arc = deadly, unspecified re-blow = slip.
R2: working on isolated equipment before the tester shows 0 V is DEADLY. This raises do_5_8_a and do_5_8_b from slip and matches M1 step 18 and 2.6/2.9. Earthing before the test stays a slip (4.1a).

R7: an in-service line (tripping and reclosing) may be patrolled from the ground without a PTW. Every climb or touch on it is deadly. Lessons 5.2b and 5.7b and gate case F all depend on this. R6: patrolling a tripped or locked-out feeder before the PTW is a slip. do_5_2_a and do_5_7_a now start with a PTW docket chip.
Fallen wire: entering 10 m = deadly (R13), a long stride out of the zone = deadly (R15; lesson gives the rule, not death), a cordon under 10 m = slip (R16).
do_5_6_b: a bystander's contact is deadly for the player (R17; no M1 precedent) and a late stop is a slip (R18).
R32: listening to 5.8's water myth stays a slip, although the lesson calls it 'মারাত্মক ভুল!'.
R33: peg or dig before the local-authority call = slip, not deadly.
R9: the first DO re-fit on a fresh blow with no history is allowed.

Verb changes for distinctness: 5.4b patrol cut; 5.5a flag and thermal cut (engineType renamed m5_lv_street_read); 5.7a thermal cut; 5.7b and 5.2b sound homing cut; 5.2b binocular circle replaced; 5.3a open/short stamps moved to 5.6a. Approve as a set.
Evidence-gated verdicts (a right answer without its readings = slip) are used in 5.5a, 5.5b and 5.9a, and 'ask before choosing' in 5.5a. Approve this as a general rule.
Boards trimmed to 5 rounds each (dropped rounds listed in changes).

Gate: rank অ্যাডভান্সড (unlockRank(5)); content_catalog gate_m5 engineType changes from 'gate_field' to 'm5_gate_case'; badge (reuse 'ফল্ট ফাইন্ডার'?); length 5–7 min, so drop the aftershock or the history field if it runs long; case F only if R7 is accepted.

Source-text fixes in tool/all_training_chapters_bn.json: 5.6 (प्रचंड, टकराলে, টকরানো, شدید), 5.7 ('дорогу', '보이는'), 5.8 ('শদিদ'), 5.10 ('அவை', 'निरीक्षण, परीक्षण … विश्लेषण'), 5.1 ('टकरा'). On-screen text uses clean Bangla until these are fixed.

Audio: new rival clips are needed for every coworker line that is new or a myth (tool/rival_clip.py). Guide, operator, neighbour and villager lines use device TTS. No YouTube ids yet for 5.x Learn boards.

Content to confirm with a lineman: the hand bend-test for annealing (5.3b); judging thermal hotspots against the same joint on the other two phases (5.10a); measuring at the LTDB instead of the LT bushing (5.5a).

lessonTitleBn: ফিউজ বারবার উড়ে যাওয়ার কারণ: অস্থায়ী বনাম স্থায়ী ফল্ট

level.verb: read and run the re-blow clock
level.scene: 11 kV spur with two DTRs per play; dropped DO barrel; van bonnet with the logbook (stopwatch dial in the corner) and two identical stamps 'স্থায়ী' / 'অস্থায়ী'; time-lapse sky layer.
flow: Guide first: 'একই লাইনে ফিউজ বারবার উড়ছে! কী ধরনের ফল্ট — বুঝে তবে কাজ।'
Today's page dealt: empty / 'লাগানো · ধরে রাখল 0 সে · বিকট শব্দ, আগুনের ঝলক' / 'লাগানো · ধরে রাখল 3 ঘ 30 মি · ঝড়ো হাওয়া'. Swipe back for older pages (noise).
Hold the DO to re-fit, or drag a stamp onto today's line. Re-fit on an instant-blast page = deadly; on a delayed page = slip.
Fresh page: re-fit allowed; the clock starts. Permanent: instant blast, 0 সে written. Transient: hold the clock to run the time-lapse; a weather sign comes and the barrel drops; held time written.

Permanent call: coworker after the stamp's reason. Then (CHANGED, pole-to-pole patrol cut as a 3.2/do/1 and 5.7a look-alike) an order deck: 'পেট্রোলিং দল পাঠাও' (right) / 'আরেকবার লাগাও' (deadly) / 'মোটা তার দিয়ে বাঁধো' (deadly) → ◆ → 'কেন আবার চার্জ না করে পেট্রোলিং?'.
Transient call: a 3-picture 'কোথায় দেখবেন?' deck built from the dealt spans (one sag-or-branch picture right) → ◆ → 'কেন এই জায়গাগুলো দেখলেন?'.
level.dealtVariety: Order of permanent and transient; page state (history in ≥50 % of plays); held time and weather sign; picture deals; place and time; coworker side; libraries.
deadly: Re-fitting after an instant blast with arc, from the page or just seen (R8).
Listening to the Fault Burning coworker (R8).
Choosing 'আরেকবার লাগাও' or the thick wire in the order deck (R8, R26).
slips: Re-fitting after a delayed blow before checking (R10).
level.coworkerPushBn: Permanent call, right after the stamp's reason, input held. Myth 1 word for word: 'লাইনটা কয়েকবার চার্জ করে দেখলেই ফল্টটা জ্বলে গিয়ে নিজে থেকেই ঠিক হয়ে যাবে।' Guide 'কী করবেন?'. Right: 'না — এটা ফল্ট বার্নিং, কঠোরভাবে নিষিদ্ধ। আগে পেট্রোলিং।' Wrong: 'ঠিক, দু-তিনবার লাগিয়ে দেখি।' / 'ছোট ফল্ট, পুড়ে গেলে লাইন চলবে।' Listening = deadly.
reasonQuestionsBn: কেন আবার চার্জ না করে পেট্রোলিং?
level.gestureHints: Page-flip swipe then an equal lap over DO hold-ring and the stamp pad (both stamps wiggle together). Clock: hold-ring when it is the only control. Decks: pulse over all cards.
lessonPoints: লক্ষণ: ফিউজ লাগানোর পর লাইনটি কিছু সময় (কয়েক সেকেন্ড থেকে কয়েক ঘন্টা) ধরে ঠিকঠাক চলে এবং তারপর আবার উড়ে যায়।
লক্ষণ: ফিউজ লাগানোর সাথে সাথেই একটি বড় বিস্ফোরণ এবং আর্ক সহ ফিউজটি আবার উড়ে যায়।
এই ক্ষেত্রে, লাইন পুনরায় চার্জ করার চেষ্টা করা একটি মারাত্মক ভুল।
লাইনের যে অংশে তারগুলো খুব বেশি ঝুলে আছে বা গাছের ডাল খুব কাছাকাছি, সেই জায়গাগুলো ভালোভাবে পরীক্ষা করুন।
level.giveawayRisks: Logbook writes facts only; identical stamps; history-page plays make 're-fit first' wrong; 1 s hold; picture cards dealt with real decoys (normal sag, safe trees). Distinct from M4 do_4_4_b (spark vs re-blow at one DO): here the hands-on is reading and running the clock.

unsupported: LT carrier handling on a live box and DO closing technique are not taught here (automatic animations).
Putting healthy LT ways back and the red tag are game devices.
The abnormal sound's character is synthesized.
The time-lapse is a game device for the line history.
Fixes for a transient spot (trimming, re-sagging) are not in 5.4.
